7    /// Create new PDF document with version.
8    pub fn with_version<S: Into<String>>(version: S) -> Document {
9        let mut document = Self::new();
10        document.version = version.into();
11        document
12    }

14    /// Create an object ID.
15    pub fn new_object_id(&mut self) -> ObjectId {
16        self.max_id += 1;
17        (self.max_id, 0)
18    }
19
20    /// Add PDF object into document's object list.
21    pub fn add_object<T: Into<Object>>(&mut self, object: T) -> ObjectId {
22        self.max_id += 1;
23        let id = (self.max_id, 0);
24        self.objects.insert(id, object.into());
25        id
26    }
27
28    pub fn set_object<T: Into<Object>>(&mut self, id: ObjectId, object: T) {
29        self.objects.insert(id, object.into());
30    }
31
32    /// Remove PDF object from document's object list.
33    ///
34    /// Other objects may still hold references to this object! Therefore, removing the object might
35    /// lead to dangling references.
36    pub fn remove_object(&mut self, object_id: &ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
37        self.objects.remove(object_id);
38        Ok(())
39    }
40
41    /// Remove annotation from the document.
42    ///
43    /// References to this annotation are removed from the pages' lists of annotations. Finally, the
44    /// annotation object itself is removed.
45    pub fn remove_annot(&mut self, object_id: &ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
46        for (_, page_id) in self.get_pages() {
47            let page = self.get_object_mut(page_id)?.as_dict_mut()?;
48            let annots = page.get_mut(b"Annots")?.as_array_mut()?;
49
50            annots.retain(|object| {
51                if let Ok(id) = object.as_reference() {
52                    return id != *object_id;
53                }
54
55                true
56            });
57        }
58
59        self.remove_object(object_id)?;
60
61        Ok(())
62    }

64    /// Get the page's resource dictionary.
65    ///
66    /// Get Object that has the key "Resources".
67    pub fn get_or_create_resources(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<&mut Object> {
68        let resources_id = {
69            let page = self.get_object(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict)?;
70            if page.has(b"Resources") { page.get(b"Resources").and_then(Object::as_reference).ok() } else { None }
71        };
72        if let Some(res_id) = resources_id {
73            return self.get_object_mut(res_id);
74        }
75        let page = self.get_object_mut(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)?;
76        if !page.has(b"Resources") {
77            page.set(b"Resources", Dictionary::new());
78        }
79        page.get_mut(b"Resources")
80    }
81
82    /// Add XObject to a page.
83    ///
84    /// Get Object that has the key `Resources -> XObject`.
85    pub fn add_xobject<N: Into<Vec<u8>>>(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId, xobject_name: N, xobject_id: ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
86        if let Ok(resources) = self.get_or_create_resources(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut) {
87            if !resources.has(b"XObject") {
88                resources.set("XObject", Dictionary::new());
89            }
90            let mut xobjects = resources.get_mut(b"XObject")?;
91            if let Object::Reference(xobjects_ref_id) = xobjects {
92                let mut xobjects_id = *xobjects_ref_id;
93                while let Object::Reference(id) = self.get_object(xobjects_id)? {
94                    xobjects_id = *id;
95                }
96                xobjects = self.get_object_mut(xobjects_id)?;
97            }
98            let xobjects = Object::as_dict_mut(xobjects)?;
99            xobjects.set(xobject_name, Object::Reference(xobject_id));
100        }
101        Ok(())
102    }
103
104    /// Add Graphics State to a page.
105    ///
106    /// Get Object that has the key `Resources -> ExtGState`.
107    pub fn add_graphics_state<N: Into<Vec<u8>>>(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId, gs_name: N, gs_id: ObjectId) -> Result<()> {
108        if let Ok(resources) = self.get_or_create_resources(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut) {
109            if !resources.has(b"ExtGState") {
110                resources.set("ExtGState", Dictionary::new());
111            }
112            let states = resources.get_mut(b"ExtGState").and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)?;
113            states.set(gs_name, Object::Reference(gs_id));
114        }
115        Ok(())
116    }

118    /// Add font to a page.
119    /// # Examples
120    ///
121    /// ```ignore
122    /// // Assuming you have a font file at "./SomeFont.ttf"
123    /// use ravenrs_pdf::third_party::lopdf::dictionary;
124    ///
125    /// let font_file = std::fs::read("./SomeFont.ttf").unwrap();
126    ///
127    /// // Create a new FontData instance with the font file.
128    /// let font_name = "SomeFont".to_string();
129    /// let mut font_data = ravenrs_pdf::third_party::lopdf::FontData::new(&font_file, font_name.clone());
130    ///
131    /// // Customize the font data if needed.
132    /// font_data
133    ///     .set_italic_angle(10)
134    ///     .set_encoding("WinAnsiEncoding".to_string());
135    ///
136    ///
137    /// // Create a new PDF document.
138    /// let mut doc = ravenrs_pdf::third_party::lopdf::Document::with_version("1.5");
139    ///
140    /// // Add the font to the document.
141    /// let font_id = doc.add_font(font_data).unwrap();
142    ///
143    /// // Now you can use `font_id` to reference the font in your PDF content.
144    /// // For example:
145    /// let resources_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
146    ///  "Font" => dictionary! {
147    ///         font_name => font_id,
148    ///     },
149    /// });
150    /// ```
151    #[cfg(any())]
152    pub fn add_font(&mut self, font_data: FontData) -> Result<ObjectId> {
153        // Create embedded font stream
154        let font_stream = Stream::new(
155            dictionary! {
156                "Length1" => Object::Integer(font_data.bytes().len() as i64),
157            },
158            font_data.bytes(),
159        );
160        let font_file_id = self.add_object(font_stream);
161        let font_name = font_data.font_name.clone();
162
163        // Create font descriptor dictionary
164        let font_descriptor_id = self.add_object(dictionary! {
165            "Type" => "FontDescriptor",
166            "FontName" => Object::Name(font_name.clone().into_bytes()),
167            "Flags" => Object::Integer(font_data.flags),
168            "FontBBox" => Object::Array(vec![
169                Object::Integer(font_data.font_bbox.0),
170                Object::Integer(font_data.font_bbox.1),
171                Object::Integer(font_data.font_bbox.2),
172                Object::Integer(font_data.font_bbox.3),
173            ]),
174            "ItalicAngle" => Object::Integer(font_data.italic_angle),
175            "Ascent" => Object::Integer(font_data.ascent),
176            "Descent" => Object::Integer(font_data.descent),
177            "CapHeight" => Object::Integer(font_data.cap_height),
178            "StemV" => Object::Integer(font_data.stem_v),
179            "FontFile2" => Object::Reference(font_file_id),
180        });
181
182        // Create font dictionary
183        let font_id = self.add_object(dictionary! {
184            "Type" => "Font",
185            "Subtype" => "TrueType",
186            "BaseFont" => Object::Name(font_name.clone().into_bytes()),
187            "FontDescriptor" => Object::Reference(font_descriptor_id),
188            "Encoding" => Object::Name(font_data.encoding.into_bytes()),
189        });
190
191        if let Some(first_char) = font_data.first_char {
192            self.get_dictionary_mut(font_id).unwrap().set("FirstChar", Object::Integer(first_char));
193        }
194        if let Some(last_char) = font_data.last_char {
195            self.get_dictionary_mut(font_id).unwrap().set("LastChar", Object::Integer(last_char));
196        }
197        if let Some(widths_array) = font_data.widths {
198            let widths = widths_array.into_iter().map(Object::Integer).collect();
199            self.get_dictionary_mut(font_id).unwrap().set("Widths", Object::Array(widths));
200        }
201
202        Ok(font_id)
203    }
204}

229    pub fn create_document_with_texts(texts_for_pages: &[&str]) -> Document {
230        let mut doc = Document::with_version("1.5");
231        let info_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
232            "Title" => Object::string_literal("Create PDF document example"),
233            "Creator" => Object::string_literal("https://crates.io/crates/lopdf"),
234            "CreationDate" => get_timestamp(),
235        });
236        let pages_id = doc.new_object_id();
237        let font_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
238            "Type" => "Font",
239            "Subtype" => "Type1",
240            "BaseFont" => "Courier",
241        });
242        let resources_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
243            "Font" => dictionary! {
244                "F1" => font_id,
245            },
246        });
247        let contents = texts_for_pages.iter().map(|text| Content {
248            operations: vec![
249                Operation::new("BT", vec![]),
250                Operation::new("Tf", vec!["F1".into(), 48.into()]),
251                Operation::new("Td", vec![100.into(), 600.into()]),
252                Operation::new("Tj", vec![Object::string_literal(*text)]),
253                Operation::new("ET", vec![]),
254            ],
255        });
256
257        let pages = contents.map(|content| {
258            let content_id = doc.add_object(Stream::new(dictionary! {}, content.encode().unwrap()));
259            let page = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
260                "Type" => "Page",
261                "Parent" => pages_id,
262                "Contents" => content_id,
263            });
264            page.into()
265        });
266
267        let pages = dictionary! {
268            "Type" => "Pages",
269            "Kids" => pages.collect::<Vec<Object>>(),
270            "Count" => 1,
271            "Resources" => resources_id,
272            "MediaBox" => vec![0.into(), 0.into(), 595.into(), 842.into()],
273        };
274        doc.objects.insert(pages_id, Object::Dictionary(pages));
275        let catalog_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
276            "Type" => "Catalog",
277            "Pages" => pages_id,
278        });
279        doc.trailer.set("Root", catalog_id);
280        doc.trailer.set("Info", info_id);
281        doc.trailer.set("ID", Object::Array(vec![Object::string_literal(b"ABC"), Object::string_literal(b"DEF")]));
282        doc.compress();
283        doc
284    }

286    /// Create a single-page document whose content stream is the
287    /// caller-supplied list of operations (wrapped in `BT`/`ET` if not
288    /// already). Used by tests that need to exercise specific
289    /// content-stream operators not produced by `create_document_with_texts`.
290    pub fn create_document_with_operations(operations: Vec<Operation>) -> Document {
291        let mut doc = Document::with_version("1.5");
292        let info_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
293            "Title" => Object::string_literal("Create PDF document example"),
294            "Creator" => Object::string_literal("https://crates.io/crates/lopdf"),
295            "CreationDate" => get_timestamp(),
296        });
297        let pages_id = doc.new_object_id();
298        let font_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
299            "Type" => "Font",
300            "Subtype" => "Type1",
301            "BaseFont" => "Courier",
302        });
303        let resources_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
304            "Font" => dictionary! {
305                "F1" => font_id,
306            },
307        });
308        let content = Content { operations };
309        let content_id = doc.add_object(Stream::new(dictionary! {}, content.encode().unwrap()));
310        let page = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
311            "Type" => "Page",
312            "Parent" => pages_id,
313            "Contents" => content_id,
314        });
315        let pages = dictionary! {
316            "Type" => "Pages",
317            "Kids" => vec![page.into()],
318            "Count" => 1,
319            "Resources" => resources_id,
320            "MediaBox" => vec![0.into(), 0.into(), 595.into(), 842.into()],
321        };
322        doc.objects.insert(pages_id, Object::Dictionary(pages));
323        let catalog_id = doc.add_object(dictionary! {
324            "Type" => "Catalog",
325            "Pages" => pages_id,
326        });
327        doc.trailer.set("Root", catalog_id);
328        doc.trailer.set("Info", info_id);
329        doc.trailer.set("ID", Object::Array(vec![Object::string_literal(b"ABC"), Object::string_literal(b"DEF")]));
330        doc.compress();
331        doc
332    }

334    /// Save a document
335    pub fn save_document(file_path: &PathBuf, doc: &mut Document) {
336        let res = doc.save(file_path);
337
338        assert!(match res {
339            Ok(_file) => true,
340            Err(_e) => false,
341        });
342    }

356    #[cfg(any())]
357    #[cfg(any())]
358    fn test_add_font_embeds_font_correctly() {
359        // Create a dummy TTF font in memory (fake content, just to test structure)
360        let font_file = std::fs::read("./assets/fonts/Montserrat-Regular.ttf").unwrap();
361
362        // Construct FontData manually
363        let mut font_data = FontData::new(&font_file, "MyFont".to_string());
364        font_data
365            .set_flags(32)
366            .set_font_bbox((0, -200, 1000, 800))
367            .set_italic_angle(0)
368            .set_ascent(750)
369            .set_descent(-250)
370            .set_cap_height(700)
371            .set_stem_v(80)
372            .set_encoding("WinAnsiEncoding".to_string());
373
374        // Create PDF document
375        let mut doc = Document::with_version("1.5");
376
377        // Create dummy page
378        let page_id = doc.new_object_id();
379        doc.set_object(page_id, dictionary! {});
380
381        // Add font
382        let font_id = doc.add_font(font_data.clone()).unwrap();
383
384        // Font dictionary must exist
385        let font_obj = doc.get_object(font_id).unwrap();
386        let font_dict = font_obj.as_dict().unwrap();
387
388        // Check base font name
389        assert_eq!(font_dict.get(b"BaseFont").unwrap(), &Object::Name(b"MyFont".to_vec()));
390
391        // Check encoding
392        assert_eq!(font_dict.get(b"Encoding").unwrap(), &Object::Name(b"WinAnsiEncoding".to_vec()));
393
394        // Check font descriptor exists and is referenced
395        let descriptor_ref = font_dict.get(b"FontDescriptor").unwrap().as_reference().unwrap();
396        let descriptor_obj = doc.get_object(descriptor_ref).unwrap().as_dict().unwrap();
397        assert_eq!(descriptor_obj.get(b"FontName").unwrap(), &Object::Name(b"MyFont".to_vec()));
398
399        // Check font file is embedded
400        let font_file_ref = descriptor_obj.get(b"FontFile2").unwrap().as_reference().unwrap();
401        let font_stream = doc.get_object(font_file_ref).unwrap().as_stream().unwrap();
402        assert_eq!(font_stream.content, font_file);
403    }
